    AdminApplicationManagementServlet

    Admin Global Recruitment Dashboard Servlet (US03).

    Module workload accumulator, used to count the number of accepted positions, total workload, and hired TA set for each module.

    TA workload accumulator, used to count the number of accepted positions, total workload, and associated module set for each TA.

    Admin global recruitment dashboard view model.

    Recruitment metrics aggregated by module code.

    Workload aggregated by module based on hired TAs.

    Workload assigned to a TA based on accepted applications.

    Workload assignment entry, recording the assignment details of a single TA for a position.

    AdminWorkloadServlet.TAAccumulator
    TA workload accumulator, used to count the number of accepted positions, total workload, and associated module set for each TA.
